attributes.meta_summary: This section defines fire resistance requirements for walls and ceilings separating fire sectors based on building usage, height, and specific risk areas, as well as classification of special risk areas based on volume, surface area, power, or fire load.

toc_path: 2 Locales y zonas de riesgo especial

extractions.extraction_text: Paredes y techos(3) que separan al  sector considerado del resto del  edificio, siendo su uso previsto: (4) -  Sector de riesgo mínimo  en  edificio de cualquier uso

attributes.norm_statement: Walls and ceilings separating a minimum risk sector from the rest of the building must have a specified fire resistance.
attributes.notes: Fire resistance for walls and ceilings separating minimum risk sectors from the rest of the building, for any building use, when not below ground level.

toc_path: 2 Locales y zonas de riesgo especial

extractions.extraction_text: Paredes y techos(3) que separan al  sector considerado del resto del  edificio, siendo su uso previsto: (4) -  Residencial Vivienda, Residen cial Público, Docente, Adminis trativo

attributes.norm_statement: Walls and ceilings separating a sector with Residential Housing, Public Residential, Educational, or Administrative use from the rest of the building must have a specified fire resistance.
attributes.satisfied_if: (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == TRUE AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT <= 15 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 60' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 60'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT > 15 AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT <= 28 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 90' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 90'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT > 28 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120')
attributes.notes: Fire resistance for walls and ceilings separating sectors with Residential Housing, Public Residential, Educational, or Administrative use, varying by location (below ground or above) and evacuation height.

toc_path: 2 Locales y zonas de riesgo especial

extractions.extraction_text: Paredes y techos(3) que separan al  sector considerado del resto del  edificio, siendo su uso previsto: (4) -  Comercial,  Pública concurren cia ,  Hospitalario

attributes.norm_statement: Walls and ceilings separating a sector with Commercial, Public Assembly, or Hospital use from the rest of the building must have a specified fire resistance.
attributes.satisfied_if: (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == TRUE AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT <= 15 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 90' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 90'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT > 15 AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT <= 28 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 120'); OR (LOCATION.BELOW_GROUND_LEVEL == FALSE AND BUILDING.EVACUATION.HEIGHT > 28 AND ELEMENT.WALL.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 180' AND ELEMENT.CEILING.FIRE_RESISTANCE == 'EI 180')
attributes.notes: Fire resistance for walls and ceilings separating sectors with Commercial, Public Assembly, or Hospital use, varying by location (below ground or above) and evacuation height.
